description: A steel bulb of nitrous oxide. Forty seconds, and then you're just a person in a room again.

effects.comeon_message: Cold on the teeth, sweet at the back of the throat.

events.text: [trip]WAH. WAH. WAH. The whole room is on the beat.[/trip]
[trip]You're laughing and the laugh arrives in slices.[/trip]
[trip]The beat slows. Something almost gets explained.[/trip]
[trip]Gone. You're standing in a room holding a balloon, and it's a bit embarrassing.[/trip]

effects.onset_message: Everything becomes a throb with a beat to it, and the beat is very funny, and the room agrees.

overdose.message: You breathe nothing but the gas for too long, and the part of you that was supposed to notice has gone out.

effects.take_line: You crack the {name} into a balloon and breathe it back in.

withdrawal.message: Your hands and feet are buzzing and have been for days. It isn't the good buzzing.

stages.easing: It backs off to your fingertips and stays there.
stages.onset: Your hands and feet start buzzing, and there's no bulb, and the buzzing goes on anyway.
stages.peak: The buzzing hasn't stopped once, and it stopped being funny somewhere in the first hour, and it's still going.
stages.rising: It's in your fingers and it's in your feet and it isn't the good buzzing.
stages.tail: Mostly gone. Something in your feet hasn't entirely agreed to that.

name: whippet
